origin.description: Studio shot of Phil: MediaPipe face-tracked 9:16 punch-in (OpenCV warpAffine, Lanczos) from a 16:9 interview frame, slow push 1.20 -> 1.26, gamma lift 1.45 for the dark room.
origin.note: Describes THIS custom shot; not a template.

reasons: OpenCV frame renderer runs on the worker; browsers cannot run it

fallback.description: editor shows the version poster; an edit requests a worker still (deterministic job with output.stillOnly) in ~2 s, then a full render on save

shotSpec.note: face track computed once at import with the production detector (blaze_face_full_range, conf 0.45, every 2nd frame, Gaussian smoothing sigma 18)

framingY.why: fraction of crop height the face sits above centre

aiEditable.what: a different source clip or in-point (needs a new face track)

protected.what: face track (stored asset), smoothing, Lanczos warp, 9:16 crop geometry
